_about: Studio editor layout per model (seed combined_playground, stage 3). Left column: Prompt box, References box; right column: Model box, LoRAs box. A model missing here gets its side's defaults. Steps, sizes and params still come from playground_models.json / image_models.json (the render plumbing validates against them).

_fields.prompt.negative: the model takes a negative prompt (shows Negative + Default negative)
_fields.prompt.default / default_negative: prefilled into the Default fields of a new tile; joined in front of the prompt at render. Left out on an image model: its prompt_default / negative_default from image_models.json
_fields.references.label: box title
_fields.references.slots: reference slots beside the main image
_fields.references.toggles: first = the main image can be the first frame or just a reference; last = a reference can be the last frame (LTX: the one slot is the end frame)
